notes.title: Terminal Shift - Upcoming Demo
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! Recently I launched a closed beta test for my upcoming game Terminal Shift, since then I have been working on a demo and its almost ready![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/0048a3e198502dfa5681f68b392f965223acefd7.png"][/img][/p][h3]GAME SUMMARY:[/h3][p]Terminal Shift is a psychological horror game that takes place in a desolate airport terminal, which has been twisted into a looping nightmare. Each loop contains a hidden number for the full access code. The code is procedurally generated and changes with each loop, storing your input along the way. The number can be anywhere on the surface of the airport or can be hidden as formed objects and even in patterns, such as flickering lights, sounds and movement. When the number is found it can be submitted into the keypad device. Collect the full 10-digit code, gain access to the boarding gates and escape.[/p][p][/p][h3]DEMO CONTENT:[/h3][p]The demo will be a short version of the game, with limited functionalities and content, but enough to get familiar with the core gameplay concept and mechanics. It will contain all of the game options, including camera comfort, field of view, audio settings, etc. Also, remappable keys and full controller support.[/p][p]The demo is scheduled to launch on September 8, 2025, 8:00 PST[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/32d629673c9dd9f3d877f0622a05eaf2981b489b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/bd32aa2745afe0ec613f456dc16eb54590d3c816.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/a02276bf6273fbe2ed15a0769ae0cfb5644e7fac.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/db180e8f5f1e22de041ec535af6cef7435086ab4.png"][/img][/p][p]Make sure to [b]follow[/b] and [b]Wishlist[/b] [b]Terminal Shift[/b] to be notified of future news and updates![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856670/Terminal_Shift/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Terminal Shift - Early Access Playtest
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, today I'm happy to announce that the first public playtest for Terminal Shift is now live and open for participation![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/f7292f53f23a5de5bd3f6d5e923bb2dd76d8d8ac.png"][/img][/p][h3]GAME SUMMARY:[/h3][p]Terminal Shift is a psychological horror game that takes place in a desolate airport terminal, which has been twisted into a looping nightmare. Each loop contains a hidden number for the full access code. The code is procedurally generated and changes with each loop, storing your input along the way. The number can be found on walls, ceilings or floor, it can also be hidden as formed objects or even in patterns such as flickering lights, sounds and movements. When the number is found it can be submitted into the keypad device. Collect the full 10-digit code, gain access to the boarding gates and escape. [/p][p][/p][h3]PLAYTEST CONTENT:[/h3][p]The playtest will be a short version of the game, but enough for testing purposes. This version of the game will have limited functionalities and content but will feature most of the main gameplay mechanics and options.[/p][p]You can now request access from the steam page: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856670/Terminal_Shift/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/7550511c1133cc654efb0f6b18edd23a65784bda.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/3ad586f1836eeeb5588b648c2aa2032c8419e613.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/db180e8f5f1e22de041ec535af6cef7435086ab4.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45693064/ac673239151a343d6addfd1f3dd2310113d9046f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER:[/h3][previewyoutube="L3Fe7FuG8FI;full"][/previewyoutube]
